Tamil Nadu launches 'Spectrum' system for repeat sexual offender monitoring

Tamil Nadu police have introduced a new system named 'Spectrum' aimed at predicting and preventing repeat sexual offenses. The initiative focuses on strengthening risk assessment for individuals identified as sexual offenders. This system is designed to classify and monitor offenders to enhance public safety.
